title: BuildToValue Policy YAML — DPO/CISO Governance Console
description: Permissive schema validated client-side by the Governance Console and server-side by scripts/validate_policy_schema.py. It accepts the diverse YAML families currently under data/policies/. Newly authored policies (created via Console Panel 1 or with --require-constitutional) must additionally carry the bias_declaration and jurisdiction constitutional fields — enforced by the script flag, not by this schema.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdictions this policy applies to. Constitutional field. Accepts string (single, comma-separated, or named region), array, or object describing a bitmask.

bias_declaration.description: Explicit declaration of bias surface the author was aware of. Constitutional field (Rawls blind-test invariant).
